headline: Small clean SE swell — dawn patrol glass before the sea breeze ruins it.
today: Waist-high SE at a fun angle and the wind stays light WNW through the morning, so you've got glassy conditions right up until the SSW cross-on fills in around midday. Get on it early, ideally around the 8:28 high or the push before it. Log or a groveler — it's on the smaller side but rideable and clean.

daysToWatch.note: Best of the weekend — N offshore dawn holds into morning with 2ft SE at a good angle. Clean log session before the wind swings, go early.
Bigger on paper but SE cross-on all day at a fair angle. Junky, skip it.
